title: Broomstick
body:
Description

The Broomstick was a vehicle obtained during the 2025 Halloween Event, unboxed it is a small drivable vehicle that floats a couple studs in the air similar to the UFO, when driving it has a top speed of around 97stds/s. you cannot store anything in the Broomstick.

Tips and Trivia

  • Given the Broomsticks ability to float and its speed and is good at traversing the world with ease
  • The Broomstick does NOT float in water, lava, acid or void water and will sink like all other vehicles
